meta.name: Surviving Jeffrey Epstein
meta.description: Surviving Jeffrey Epsteinis a four-part series that investigates the convicted sex-offender Jeffrey Epstein who used his power, influence, and finances to not only shield his predatory sexual behaviour over several decades, but successfully manipulated the justice system to avoid true penalty. Deals made in secret. Investigations suppressed. Connections to the rich and powerful, participating in the web of trafficking across the globe. Eight survivors share their stories across the series, including the testimony of Courtney Wild, Rachel Kay Benavides, and Virginia Roberts Giuffre. Through the strength of their resolve and other survivors, the series shines a light on Epstein’s tentacles, and the pursuit for real justice.
